description: Analyze the whole repository and create a verified technical report plus a self-contained AI context pack.
---

Run `.agents/skills/project-intelligence-audit/SKILL.md`.

Start at the repository root. Analyze backend, frontend, API routes, controllers/services, database schema, auth/roles, business workflows, configuration, tests, integrations, PRDs and documentation. Do not implement features or modify application code. Create the complete report package and AI_CONTEXT_PACK.md with evidence-based findings, API contracts, data model, PRD gaps, security/testing risks, integration blueprint, inspected/uninspected areas, and exact test results. Redact secrets and never claim unverified work.

If the IDE cannot load the skill automatically, read its SKILL.md directly and follow it.
